```python
# SPECTRA design program, iteration 12
# Topology: 5T NMOS-pair OTA with PMOS diode-mirror load, followed by two CMOS inverters.
# Change from iteration 11: preamp drains are set to an explicit 0.7 V target. The PMOS load
# is sized at its real Vsd (1.1 V) and in stronger inversion (gm/Id 12), so its Vsg sits above
# Vth. The pair and tail are sized at their actual Vds (0.5 V and 0.2 V). Itail = iref keeps
# power at 36 uW.

VDD = 1.8
IREF_DEFAULT = 10e-6
CG_PER_UM = 1.4e-15
VD_PRE = 0.7     # preamp drain target (V)
VTAIL = 0.2      # tail node voltage (V)

PARAMS = {
    "gmid_in":  (20, 16, 24),      # pair gm/Id
    "L_in":     (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),   # pair length
    "gmid_ld":  (12, 8, 16),       # PMOS mirror load gm/Id (lower -> larger Vsg above Vth)
    "L_ld":     (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),   # PMOS mirror load length
    "gmid_mir": (20, 18, 26),      # NMOS bias mirror gm/Id (ref and tail share it)
    "kt":       (1.0, 0.9, 1.0),   # tail current ratio: Itail = kt * iref (power cap)
    "Wa":       (1.0, 0.42, 2.0),  # inverter A NMOS width (um)
    "rA":       (2.5, 2.0, 4.0),   # inverter A PMOS/NMOS width ratio
    "Wb":       (3.0, 1.0, 8.0),   # inverter B NMOS width (um), PMOS = 2*Wb
}


def design(p, lut, spec):
    iref = spec.get("iref", IREF_DEFAULT)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-14)

    Itail = p["kt"] * iref
    Ihalf = 0.5 * Itail
    Wa = p["Wa"]
    Wb = p["Wb"]
    rA = p["rA"]

    # bias mirror: reference self-biased at its Vgs, tail at its actual Vds
    m_ref = lut.size("n", p["gmid_mir"], 0.5, iref, vds=0.7)
    m_tail = lut.size("n", p["gmid_mir"], 0.5, Itail, vds=VTAIL)

    # pair sized at drain-tail Vds, load sized at VDD-drain Vsd
    m_in = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], Ihalf, vds=VD_PRE - VTAIL)
    m_ld = lut.size("p", p["gmid_ld"], p["L_ld"], Ihalf, vds=VDD - VD_PRE)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MREF", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m_ref)
    n.dev("MTAIL", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m_tail)
    n.dev("MINP", "outp", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m_in)
    n.dev("MINN", "outn", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m_in)
    n.dev("MLDD", "outp", "outp", "vdd", "vdd", m_ld)
    n.dev("MLDM", "outn", "outp", "vdd", "vdd", m_ld)
    n.M("MIAN", "x", "outn", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wa, 0.15)
    n.M("MIAP", "x", "outn", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", rA * Wa, 0.15)
    n.M("MIBN", "vout", "x", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wb, 0.15)
    n.M("MIBP", "vout", "x", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 2.0 * Wb, 0.15)

    # first-order predictions
    gain1 = m_in.gm / (m_in.gds + m_ld.gds)

    # outn node: inverter A gate + pair drain + mirror drain
    Cn = m_in.cdd + m_ld.cdd + CG_PER_UM * Wa * (1.0 + rA)
    # x node: inverter B gate + inverter A drain
    Cx = CG_PER_UM * 3.0 * Wb + CG_PER_UM * Wa * (1.0 + rA) * 0.5

    # preamp must swing from its drain level (0.7 V) to the inverter threshold (~0.9 V)
    t1 = Cn * (0.9 - VD_PRE) / Ihalf
    # inverter A drives x node
    t2 = Cx * 0.9 / (0.4e-3 * Wa)
    # inverter B drives the load
    t3 = cl * (VDD / 2) / (0.4e-3 * Wb)
    tpd = t1 + t2 + t3

    # supply: reference branch + tail (inverters draw no static current)
    power = VDD * (iref + Itail)

    # offset referred to the preamp gate
    offset = 0.01 / gain1

    return n, {"tpd": tpd, "power": power, "offset": offset, "polarity_ok": 1}
```
